title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Fees in the Late-Fee Basis of a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
**Rule.** Where a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is in active status, its monthly protection fee, billed on the same due date as the rent, is added to the rent basis before the late-fee percentage is applied; where the agreement's plan has lapsed, the protection fees it still owes are added instead; where no plan is attached to the agreement, nothing is added.

The plan is the Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan record attached to that rental agreement. Its status (active or lapsed), its monthly protection fee and its protection fees owed are read from that plan record.

## Input, judgement, output

| Protection plan on the agreement | Added to the rent basis before the percentage |
|---|---|
| active | the plan's monthly protection fee |
| lapsed | the protection fees the lapsed plan still owes |
| none attached | nothing — the percentage is applied to the rent basis alone |

## Hypothetical cases (15% late-fee percentage, rent basis $150.00)

- Active plan with a $12.00 monthly fee: the percentage is applied to $162.00, giving $24.30.
- Lapsed plan owing $36.00 in protection fees: the percentage is applied to $186.00, giving $27.90.
- No plan attached: the percentage is applied to $150.00, giving $22.50.
